DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Rheumatic Fever.

The normal inflammatory markers and negative autoimmune screen help rule out SLE and severe sepsis, but the combination of fever, seizure, rash, and lack of tick exposure strongly suggests Group A Streptococcal infection leading to rheumatic fever. The rash is likely Erythema Marginatum. I will proceed with your care based on this finding.
